recommendation: Keep the source fix. It aligns the conditional create section with the accepted 2015 optionality guidance and avoids changing any later conformance behavior beyond the interaction name.
issue_request: FHIR-7928 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked to remove conditional create support, but the approved motion kept conditional create and directed the specification to explain that transactions and conditional operations are complex and not expected on every server.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision #5340, corresponding to git commit 51d2438efb. That commit added the shared optionality/complexity note to conditional update, conditional delete, conditional create, and transaction sections in source/http.html.
additional_context: FHIR-7928 is directly linked by FHIR-7927 comments and its resolution states that the same resolution should apply to FHIR-7926 and FHIR-7927. Later commit 8d445f4fd52 changed the conditional create note from conditional create to conditional update while standardizing the error/OperationOutcome wording.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html in the conditional create section from "Servers that don't support the conditional update" to "Servers that don't support the conditional create" while preserving the later 400/MAY OperationOutcome wording.
source_changes: source/http.html: in the conditional create section, changed the unsupported-interaction sentence to name conditional create instead of conditional update.
